research_stage: Interface gate before returning to phenomenon and strong-baseline screening; no method increment established
motivation: Both arms passed all eight supplied-action encoding fixtures, so the simple calibration did not reproduce malformed outputs in the research workflow.
selection: All four first-request contexts from each of the already-used positive and strength symmetric development batches. Retain successful and malformed historical cells alike. Selection of these two batches is post-hoc development debugging, not a representative sample or independent confirmation.
units: Two task pairs, eight dependent contexts, sixteen planned first-response calls. Never treat these as sixteen independent tasks.
intervention: Replace exactly one canonical action instruction in the system message with the existing separated-alternatives instruction. Hold the entire remaining payload constant within each pair. The instruction is a presentation bundle, not a test of commas alone.
model_task: Choose the first action under the unchanged recorded research prompt, unlike the prior supplied-action encoding check. No action is prescribed or graded as semantically correct.
execution: No SQL or tool dispatch, even for valid requests. No fabricated tool observations. A future runner must enforce one response per slot and retain all failures. This draft has no API transport or executable paid launcher.
order: Fixed SHA-256 context order with alternating first arm; four original-first and four separated-first pairs. No added repetitions based on results.
primary: For all sixteen planned slots: normal-finish plus strict whole-response action-schema admission, with invalid, infrastructure-failed and not-started states distinct. No prefix extraction or repair.
secondary: descriptive paired admission difference only after all slots observed
historical_comparison: New paired responses only. Do not estimate a treatment effect by comparing new calls with old failures or pool with synthetic encoding fixtures. Old responses and scores remain unchanged.
failure_policy: Malformed content is an observed invalid response, not a transport failure; continue the prespecified sequence. Infrastructure failure stops the batch without retries or completed-prefix contrasts. No replacement of failed cells.

decision_rules.infrastructure_failure: Audit and resolve the operational cause before interpreting formatting. No automatic rerun.
decision_rules.separated_has_invalid: Do not expand substantive experiments with this candidate. Pause prompt tweaking and reassess an explicit structured interface, preserving this failure. Any replacement is a new protocol and separate authorization.
decision_rules.both_all_admitted: No observed advantage and no general reliability claim. Keep the original instruction for continuity if proceeding; add no interface component as a research contribution. Any renewed substantive study requires a new frozen design and approval.
decision_rules.separated_all_admitted_original_has_inva: Provisional interface candidate, not root-cause proof. A subsequent substantive development batch must use it equally across every baseline and treatment; no retroactive repair of older results.

scope_cautions: Temperature zero does not guarantee reproducibility, and the remote model alias does not independently identify immutable weights. First-response validity does not establish multi-step interface reliability. Do not repeatedly optimize these two tasks until expected cache behavior appears.
next_research_gate: Once the interface is usable, test legitimate reuse and direct recomputation under fair information before proposing a new algorithm. A valid route or wrong final answer alone cannot establish demand reinterpretation.
budget: Use measured token lengths for planning. Recheck prices, finalize frozen launcher and failure tests, then obtain fresh bounded paid approval. No credentials or previous approvals are reused.
